instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-02_input.step. Keep the outside envelope of the 190 x 90 x 12 mm plate unchanged. Cut six vertical through holes: diameter 6 mm at (28,22), diameter 8 mm at (72,22), diameter 10 mm at (116,22), diameter 6 mm at (162,22), diameter 8 mm at (50,65), and diameter 10 mm at (140,65). Cut a through obround slot centered at (95,48), length 44 mm along X and width 10 mm. Cut a second through obround slot centered at (32,58), length 30 mm along Y and width 8 mm. Cut a 10 mm radius semicircular notch centered on the left edge at (0,45) and a 14 mm radius semicircular notch centered on the right edge at (190,45), both through the full thickness. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-02_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). For this task, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-02_input.step`.
